001package models;
002
003import base.User;
004import enums.Role;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.List;
007
008/**
009 * Student user with course enrollment, marks, and transcript support.
010 */
011public class Student extends User {
012    private static final long serialVersionUID = 2L;
013
014    private List<String> enrolledCourses = new ArrayList<>();
015    private List<Course> enrolledCourseObjects = new ArrayList<>();
016    private List<Mark> marks = new ArrayList<>();
017
018    public Student(String login, String password, String name) {
019        super(login, hashPassword(password), name, Role.STUDENT);
020    }
021
022    public List<String> getEnrolledCourses() {
023        if (enrolledCourses == null) enrolledCourses = new ArrayList<>();
024        return enrolledCourses;
025    }
026
027    public List<Course> getEnrolledCourseObjects() {
028        if (enrolledCourseObjects == null) enrolledCourseObjects = new ArrayList<>();
029        return enrolledCourseObjects;
030    }
031
032    public void addMark(Mark mark) {
033        if (mark == null) return;
034        if (marks == null) marks = new ArrayList<>();
035        marks.removeIf(m -> m.getCourse().equals(mark.getCourse()));
036        marks.add(mark);
037    }
038
039    public List<Mark> getMarks() {
040        if (marks == null) marks = new ArrayList<>();
041        return marks;
042    }
043
044    public Mark getMarkForCourse(Course course) {
045        if (marks == null) marks = new ArrayList<>();
046        for (Mark m : marks) {
047            if (m.getCourse().equals(course)) return m;
048        }
049        return null;
050    }
051
052    public Transcript getTranscript() {
053        return new Transcript(this);
054    }
055
056    @Override
057    public String getDetails() {
058        int courseCount = enrolledCourseObjects == null ? 0 : enrolledCourseObjects.size();
059        return String.format("Student: %s (%s), %d enrolled courses", name, login, courseCount);
060    }
061}
